purpose: Paper-only mandate for the firm's time-series momentum book, the best-supported family in the Fincept evidence base (tsmom_futures). Backtested with the Laboratorio engine on 24 Yahoo proxies of Liquid markets, 2000-03 to 2026-09: L6 net Sharpe 0.55, PSR 0.996, DSR 0.963, but PBO 0.657 (fails). Paper only; not eligible for live money.

signal.rule: sign of the past L-month return per asset; trade only when at least 3 of the 4 lookbacks agree (consensus)
signal.data: monthly adjusted closes from quant_evidence.app.yahoo_sync, last complete month

selection_when_capped: first legs where all 4 lookbacks agree, round-robin across asset classes (commodity, fx, index, stock), lowest 12-month volatility first within a class; then 3-of-4 legs the same way

exits.stop_loss: 2 monthly standard deviations from entry (2 x vol_12m_ann / sqrt(12)), inside the order
exits.rebalance: monthly, after the month closes; every change is a new proposal the owner approves
